question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**highly**" emphasizes the degree to which spyware attacks are malicious and disruptive.
 
• "Highly" is used to describe something that is very intense or severe.
 
• The other options: "**mainly**" (primarily), "**largely**" (mostly), and "**usually**" (normally) do not convey the same level of intensity.

**Complete Sentence:** *Since so much of our lives are digital today, such spyware attacks are highly__ malicious and disruptive.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mainly** means primarily or chiefly.
 
• **Largely** means mostly or for the most part.
 
• **Usually** means commonly or under normal conditions.
